subject: Veltis Health expansion — additional apps, term amendment & API key rollout
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Turner <evan.turner@veltishealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Veltis Health expansion — additional apps, term amendment & API key rollout

Hi Evan,

Great to see the pilot traction — congrats to your team. Per our conversation this morning, I’m summarizing the proposed expansion so we can lock terms and the rollout schedule. High level: Veltis wants to add 4 additional internal apps (Project Beacon, Intake, Triage, and CaseMapper), increase committed capacity by 30% for the next 12 months, and get separate API keys per app for governance.

Quick summary: 
- Commitment: +30% token-month commitment (12-month amendment starting 2028-08-01)
- Pricing: 8% blended uplift on hosted unit price for committed capacity; overage rates unchanged
- API keys: 4 new keys, one per app, with scoped rate limits and rotation schedule
- Rollout: staged distribution — sandbox keys next week, production keys after canary (2w), full rollout by 2028-09-15

Requests from your side I recollected: procurement wants an SOW + cost breakdown and a simple key provisioning CSV for their infra team. I’ll route those to you midday Thursday latest. If procurement needs a formal amendment instead of SOW, let me know and we’ll send both.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a draft SOW, pricing worksheet, and key CSV (internal ops to prepare).
2) Veltis to confirm signers and procurement timeline.
3) Schedule a 30-min alignment with your platform lead for key scoping (rate limits, IP allowlist, rotation cadence).

Can you confirm procurement contact and whether a PO or DocuSign is preferred?

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa and Ben to prepare the attachments.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0172 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Turner <evan.turner@veltishealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leslie Park <leslie.park@veltishealth.com>, platform@veltishealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Veltis Health expansion — additional apps, term amendment & API key rollout

Dylan — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few things from our side:

- Procurement point: Leslie Park (cc’d) will own the contract execution. PO is preferred but we can sign via DocuSign if you need faster turnaround.
- Timeline: procurement wants the SOW + cost breakdown by end of week so they can target an approval window the week of 7/24.
- Security/Platform ask: our platform team would like scoped keys (ingest vs. retrieval) and per-key rate caps. They’ll join the alignment call.

For clarity, can you make the SOW call out the following: expected token growth profile month-over-month, clear definition of committed vs. overage units, and a short rollback policy if performance or quality issues surface during the canary?

We’re good with the staged rollout you proposed. Please include a one-page executive summary for our CFO.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Turner
Head of Product, Veltis Health
+1 917-555-0199

On Tue, Jul 11, 2028 at 10:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Veltis Health expansion — SOW, key CSV, cost workbook (action items)

Team — forwarding Evan's reply and procurement timeline. Need a tight bundle by COB Friday (7/15):

Action items:
- Marissa: Draft a short SOW (1–2 pages + appendix) that includes: amendment effective date 2028-08-01, committed units + 30% uplift for 12 months, rollback clause for canary performance, and signatory block for Leslie Park.
- Ben: Build the cost-breakdown workbook showing baseline, committed pricing, proposed 8% uplift, and example month-over-month token growth. Add a 1-page CFO summary.
- Laura: Prepare the key provisioning CSV with columns: project_name, env (sandbox/prod), suggested_rate_limit, key_id_placeholder, owner_email. Default rotation cadence 90 days and provide a short note about HSM/KMS recommendations for the production keys.

Also prep a short canary checklist (health metrics, SLOs, rollback triggers) we can attach. Evan asked for sandbox keys next week so include a separate tab in the CSV with sandbox credentials placeholders.

I’ll assemble into a single packet and run a quick internal legal run if needed. If any of the asks are heavy, flag it and we’ll scope down for procurement.

Thanks — Dylan

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Turner <evan.turner@veltishealth.com>, Leslie Park <leslie.park@veltishealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Veltis expansion — SOW, cost worksheet, and key CSV (attached)

Hi Evan / Leslie,

Attached is the packet we discussed: Redwood_SOW_Veltis_2028-07-18.pdf, cost-breakdown-commit-2028.xlsx, and veltis-api-keylist-4projects.csv. Highlights:

- Amendment: effective 2028-08-01, adds 30% committed capacity for 12 months.
- Pricing: 8% blended uplift on committed units. See workbook tab "CFO Summary" for annualized impact and month-by-month examples.
- Keys: four prod keys (placeholders in CSV) for Project Beacon, Intake, Triage, CaseMapper. Sandbox placeholders included. Suggested per-key rate limits: 250 RPS for ingest services, 150 RPS for retrieval flows; we recommend separate service accounts per app.
- Canary & rollback: defined 14-day canary window, SLOs (p95 latency < 120ms, error rate <0.5%), and rollback triggers (quality regression detected by eval suite or sustained latency over SLO).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Leslie: confirm PO vs DocuSign and preferred signer (we populated Leslie as procurement lead in the SOW).
2) Veltis platform: pick two engineers for the 30-min scoping call this week (we have openings Thu 7/19 11am PT and Fri 7/20 9am PT).
3) Once PO/SOW confirmed, we will provision sandbox keys within 24 hours and production keys following successful canary.

DocuSign link (SOW) for quick signature: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/sign?doc=VEL-SOW-2028-07-18
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VEL-2028-EXP-03

If everything looks good I can submit the amendment to legal and start provisioning placeholders.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
